contract: design-contract.md: exact, ledger-backed public money flows with clear withdrawal states, separate donor-covered fees, private banking data and a graceful unavailable state.

accessibility.evidence: axe WCAG2 A/AA and 2.1 AA: zero violations on desktop and mobile including expanded breakdown; native details and labelled dates/withdrawal states reviewed.

responsive.evidence: No document overflow on desktop/mobile, including a wallet balance beyond Number precision. Rows stack amount below copy on mobile.

loading.reason: This server-rendered section arrives with the campaign route rather than an independent client request/loading screen.

empty.evidence: Empty campaign renders explicit zero totals and No withdrawals recorded yet.

error.evidence: Unavailable trail shows reload action instead of zero figures.

partial.evidence: Failed trail leaves campaign story and Donate now control intact.

success.evidence: Paid/in-progress/returned states, exact large amounts, breakdown disclosure and page-2 navigation preserving update pagination verified.

permission.evidence: API e2e verifies drafts/review/rejected campaigns return 404; public pages expose no donor/bank/provider fields.

renderedEvidence.observation: Trail totals, highlighted wallet balance and state-labelled withdrawals beside the existing donation sidebar.
Expandable accounting identity and explicit donor-covered fee/returned-reservation explanation.
Stacked totals and wallet balance fit mobile width above the existing donate control.
Gift fees, net payouts, reserved amounts and balance remain readable.
